newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Savings Bank sees 140 mln EEK profit '97.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Savings Bank sees 140 mln EEK profit '97.

text.p: The Estonian Savings Bank said on Monday it expected the consolidated group to post a profit of 140 million kroons in 1997.
The bank's earnings are expected to be 113 million kroons and its subsidiaries are seen posting a profit of 27 million kroons, the bank said in a statement.
The profit figures for 1997 are based on an inflation forecast of 15 to 18 percent, expected five percent GDP growth and a 44 percent increase of the bank's contracted commercial net assets, it said.
The Estonian Savings Bank's net assets at the end of 1997 are expected to total 7.28 billion kroons, or 22.5 percent of all the Estonian commercial banks' aggregate net assets.
The bank's eleven months result for 1996 showed a profit of 55.47 million kroons and its net assets rose to 4.125 billion kroons.
